name: CiteAudit
description: Scientific research relies on citation integrity, yet large language models (LLMs) have introduced a critical risk: fabricated references that appear plausible but correspond to no real publications. As manual verification becomes infeasible and existing automated tools remain fragile, we introduce CiteAudit, a comprehensive benchmark and detection framework for hallucinated citations. We design a multi-agent verification pipeline that decomposes citation checking into metadata extraction, memory lookup, web-based retrieval, and final judgment.
